verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order: the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk and buried under the can, between product and headline. The can is jammed toward the top with dead space beneath it, and the sticker sits cramped beside illegibly tiny legal text at the bottom. B keeps a sensible flow (logo, headline, can, CTA), but the can is undersized and the gap above the CTA is a bit loose. B's sticker is also shrunk into an orphaned corner next to legal text too small to read.
